title: Parliament Monsoon Session Day 7 updates: Lok Sabha debates anti-paper leak Bill; punishment not enough deterrence, say Opposition MPs
content: Opposition asks for accountability for the use of force on protestors during CJP's Parliament March; VCK MP Thol. Thirumavalavan demands the abolition of the NEET exam and calls for the dismantling of National Testing Agency (NTA); Rajya Sabha adjourned for the seventh day without taking up any major agenda in the list of business

title: Non-payment of maintenance is economic abuse, constituting domestic violence: Kerala HC
content: Claims of victims of domestic violence need no independent corroboration as the harassment usually happens inside the confines of a house, says court

title: Maharashtra police flags ‘cross-border disinformation’ campaign on NEET protests
content: Anti-social elements from from Pakistan and Middle Eastern countries were amplifying misleading narratives, says cyber cell

title: India has sent ‘formal’ invite to Nepal PM Balendra Shah: MEA
content: Nepali media had reported that Mr. Shah’s advisor discussed the visit with NSA Ajit Doval during a visit to Delhi in early July; formal invite sent through diplomatic channels after PM Modi’s congratulatory remark

title: 13 Indian seafarers in ship under heavy attack in Black Sea: Union
content: Repeated drone and missile attacks are being attempted in the immediate vicinity of the vessel and the crew is living under constant fear of a direct hit at any moment, FSUI said in a post on X

title: Hearing on Gadkari's suit against deepfake posts deferred to August 5
content: The suit against Meta, X, Google and unknown persons alleges that the viral content has tarnished Union Minister Nitin Gadkari's reputation and personality rights

title: T.N. Housing Minister to inaugurate The Hindu Real Estate & Infrastructure Summit 2026 on July 30
content: Event will explore urban real estate trends, such as the expansion of GCCs, smart manufacturing hubs, AI in construction, new investment corridors, luxury housing boom, sustainable housing, and policy reforms

title: Congress’s remarks on Pralhad Joshi are misleading, condemnable, says BJP
content: ‘He (Joshi) had merely commented on the legal process and not on the matter itself,’ BJP’s media cell convenor Anil Baluni says, denying Joshi had ‘made any such statement’

title: Child rights panel resolves 46 complaints
content: Panel expresses concern over rising incidence of child rights violations among school students, says there is need to provide training to teachers and parents regarding child rights laws

title: Does digital arrest need to be made a ‘standalone offence’: Supreme Court
content: There are ingredients of robbery, extortion, dacoity... Do you need to define it as a standalone offence?, the CJI asked

title: Long-term MoUs between Sanchari Cauvery, apartments to counter skyrocketing water tanker prices
content: Many apartment communities that had come out of the dependence on private water tankers after Cauvery V Stage being commissioned in 2024 are being coerced into signing long-term contracts of two years with private water tanker businesses to get water.

title: Sashastra Seema Bal reserves 50% constable posts for ex-Agniveers, caste quota to apply
content: Although recruitment to the Army does not include caste-based reservations, the SSB says the existing quota for various categories, including SCs, STs and OBCs, will be applicable

title: Guntur police arrest six for ‘stealing’ 91 motor pump sets
content: They recover 85 pump sets, 18 kg of copper wire, two cars, and an autorickshaw allegedly used in the crimes

title: UDF names V.R. Sudheer as nominee for Kochi Corporation deputy mayor election
content: UDF has the support of 48 members in the 76-member house; LDF and BJP field candidates; Deputy mayor post had remained vacant since Deepak Joy resigned after being elected as Thripunithura MLA

title: Priyanka, Venugopal demand accountability for police action on NEET protesters
content: Accuse the Centre of responding to a democratic movement with force instead of addressing the concerns of aspirants

title: Pakistan’s Gen Z should take note of Islamabad’s support for terrorism against India: MEA
content: A supporter of terrorism, Pakistan cannot lay any claim to a “pluralistic cultural legacy” like the Indus Valley Civilisation, says MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal

title: NEET violence: Supreme Court debates yet to detail if Delhi Police kept MHA in the loop
content: The Supreme Court, over the decades, has shown a keen awareness and concern about political influence over the police

title: 35 postal bags set ablaze in Manipur as mob blocks highway for second day
content: The bags taken from a mail van intercepted on National Highway 202, contained passports, ATM cards, educational documents, and other articles

title: Union government is misleading the public on Mekedatu issue: Anbumani
content: A large-scale conspiracy is under way to deny Cauvery water to Tamil Nadu, and the Union government itself is a participant in it, says PMK leader

title: As Pampa runs shallow, cherished tradition of Aranmula faces uncertain days
content: The receding river has left several stretches of the Pampa too shallow for the iconic palliyodams to navigate

title: Vijay’s proposed visit to Bengaluru kindles public curiosity about similar missions in the mid-1980s
content: In January and February 1986 and 1987, Chief Minister M.G. Ramachandran despatched his Ministers to Bengaluru to meet their counterparts and Karnataka Chief Minister Ramakrishna Hegde and persuade them to release water for saving the paddy crop raised during the long-term samba cultivation season

title: Pleas in Supreme Court allege illegal detentions by Delhi and Bihar police
content: Volunteer who distributed food and water to protesters at Jantar Mantar and his friend allege that police seized their phones, blindfolded them and questioned them at an undisclosed location over the ‘source of funds’; law student held without arrest warrant still in Bihar police custody

title: Centre reissues notification on Western Ghats eco-sensitive zone amid deadlock with States
content: Govt. yet to resolve long-standing differences with the six Western Ghats States over the villages and regions that should be included within the zone; States apprehensive about the impact of the notification on farming, infrastructure and other development activities

title: Kochi Corporation among communicable disease hotspots
content: As many as 83 dengue cases, 78 hepatitis A cases and 26 H1N1 cases were reported within the Corporation limits between January and June; authorities intensify preventive measures, including source reduction, to curb the spread

title: ADGP M.R. Ajith Kumar challenges his suspension before Central Administrative Tribunal
content: Central Administrative Tribunal, which refused to grant a stay on the suspension order, posted the case for August 20, 2026

title: Delhi Police attempted to arrest Aishe Ghosh, alleges SFI
content: The SFI, the student wing of the Communist Party of India (Marxist) [CPI(M)], stated that its members resisted the arrest when the police barged into the party office at the AKG Bhavan

title: Akhilesh Yadav compares police action at Delhi protest to Emergency, says Pradhan’s exit saved PM
content: Former Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan’s resignation reflects the pressure generated by the student agitation; the government was compelled to abandon its ‘arrogance’, the Samajwadi Party leader says

title: Lok Sabha debates anti-paper leak Bill, Opposition terms it ‘admission of failure’
content: Congress deputy leader Gaurav Gogoi questions why the government is amending a law it had hailed as “historic” just two years ago.

title: Delhi Police authorised pellet gun use against protestors on July 20: RAF general diary entry
content: The RAF registered the diary entry at Parliament Street police station in the early hours of July 22, soon after The Hindu’s report on pellet gun injuries; following the incident, the RAF withdrew pump action guns, electric shields, anti-riot guns, shock batons from personnel deployed at Jantar Mantar

title: Former Palani MLA moves High Court for CBI probe into fraudulent registration of math land
content: K.S.N. Venugopalu Senapathi says the investigation is conducted by the CB-CID, which is under the control of the Tamil Nadu government. Since the allegations themselves extend to Registration Department officials and possibly higher authorities, the probe by an agency under the control of the State does not inspire public confidence

title: Panel examining SC status for Dalit converts yet to submit report
content: Deadline for Justice K.G. Balakrishnan-led commission expired on June 10; govt. as well as some SC associations are not in granting SC status to Dalits who convert to Islam and Christianity

title: Disruptions continue in Rajya Sabha, House adjourned for seventh day
content: Opposition members continue to protest demanding apology from government for the police action against protesters

title: SC moots independent probe into police excesses, orders release of detained minors
content: The top court ordered the immediate release of all detained protesters below the age of 18 and restrained the police from taking coercive action against student protesters or publicly disclosing their personal data

title: Naidu directs comprehensive support for farmers in A.P. amid El Niño threat
content: Chief Minister tells officials to establish a dedicated El Niño Control Room for continuous monitoring and scientific advisories through Rythu Seva Kendras; says every cultivated crop must be covered under crop insurance, for which Collectors have to take responsibility

title: Kerala Crime Branch begins detailed probe into bus driver’s death in Kollam
content: The District Police Chief (Kollam Rural) says a thorough and transparent probe is under way and strict action will be taken if any police negligence or brutality is uncovered during the investigation

title: 'It is not FIFA's to sell': UEFA blasts Infantino's $20 billion World Cup plan
content: UEFA strongly criticises FIFA's ambitious plan to create a new commercial company. This new entity aims to manage major football tournaments and seek private investment. UEFA declares that football's governing institutions have crossed a dangerous and unacceptable line. The European body questions the transparency and governance of this significant proposal. FIFA defends the plan, stating it will strengthen global football.

title: Jeff Bezos may buy stake in football club that Google DeepMind CEO is a fan of
content: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos is reportedly considering a stake in Liverpool Football Club. He is in talks to join a bid for a 30% ownership share. This potential move shifts his focus from American football investments. Bezos previously attempted to acquire the Washington Commanders team. The Seattle Seahawks sale has now been finalized by another group.

title: Archie Goodburn defies inoperable brain tumor to keep Olympic swimming dream alive
content: Archie Goodburn reached his first Commonwealth Games 50-meter breaststroke final despite living with inoperable brain cancer. The Scottish swimmer finished seventh but called the experience unforgettable. Along with chasing success in the pool, he continues to raise awareness about brain cancer, hoping future patients will benefit from better treatments and longer lives.

title: US man arrested for wiping phone during airport search; Android OS may trouble Europe travellers
content: A federal case in Atlanta questions privacy software use as criminal intent evidence. Prosecutors accuse Samuel Tunick of wiping his phone to prevent authorities from accessing its contents. GrapheneOS, a privacy-focused operating system, is central to the ongoing legal proceedings. Authorities in Europe also reportedly view GrapheneOS usage with suspicion. GrapheneOS developers state their software is legal and protects against unauthorized data extraction.

title: Pratika Rawal set for County Cricket debut, joins Warwickshire for One-Day Cup
content: Indian batter Pratika Rawal joins Warwickshire Bears for the 2026 season. She will strengthen the team's batting in the Metro Bank One-Day Cup. Rawal returns to cricket after recovering from a knee injury. Warwickshire aims for the tournament's knockout stage with her addition. She expressed excitement for county cricket and playing at Edgbaston.

title: Mast broke, phone died, water ran out. Ship found him after 30 days
content: A California man survived thirty days adrift at sea after his sailboat lost its mast. Kai Sato was found nearly nine hundred miles from Hawaii by a container ship crew. He improvised repairs and collected condensation for water while surviving on limited food. The rescue operation took about an hour and a half to complete successfully. Sato expressed deep gratitude to the ship's crew for saving his life.

title: Rare video shows Andean bear entering river in Bolivia watershed
content: A rare Andean bear has been captured on camera near the headwaters of Bolivia's Parapetí River, giving conservationists hope that the vulnerable species continues to use the protected forest. Experts say the sighting also highlights the link between wildlife conservation and protecting vital water sources.

title: How Europe's heatwave is proving Americans right about air conditioning
content: Europeans are now buying air conditioning units in unprecedented numbers. This trend is driven by record heatwaves and rising health concerns across the continent. Manufacturers report significant sales growth for cooling solutions in several European countries. Previously, air conditioning was viewed as an unnecessary luxury by many Europeans. This cultural shift reflects a growing understanding of cooling as an essential need.

title: How injured Tejaswin put aside heartbreak to help Kushare script CWG history
content: Tejaswin Shankar's Commonwealth Games high jump ended due to injury. He then coached Sarvesh Kushare, who won a historic silver medal. Kushare credited Shankar's advice for his improved performance during the competition. Shankar's own medal hopes were dashed before the event truly began. He now aims to compete in the decathlon despite his knee issue.

title: Nolan Wells death probe deepens as witness alleges heavy drinking before tragedy
content: A new ABC News report says witnesses told investigators Nolan Wells had been drinking heavily before he disappeared on Horn Island on July 4. However, officials have not determined his cause of death. The official autopsy and toxicology results are still pending, while an independent autopsy listed the death as undetermined pending investigation. Ben Crump and Wells’ family continue to seek full answers.

title: Cowboys linked to Bills' $198M, two-time Super Bowl champion in free agency
content: In an intriguing move, the Dallas Cowboys are could consider signing Texas native and pass rusher Von Miller. After expressing remorse about the recent shortcomings of his former team, Miller’s track record includes 36 pressures and 14 solo tackles last season. By bolstering their defense with Miller’s experience, the Cowboys could strengthen their ability to pressure opposing quarterbacks and improve their Super Bowl chances after 30-year drought.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes' $1.625M gift creates new hope for Texas children
content: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes made a lasting impact off the football field with a $1.625 million partnership through the 15 and the Mahomies Foundation. Announced in October 2023, the initiative supports Boys & Girls Clubs in East Texas, Greater Kansas City and Lubbock, while also funding scholarships for hundreds of children and upgrading Club facilities. Here's how the Kansas City Chiefs star and his wife turned their hometown ties into a long-term commitment to help young people build brighter futures.

title: Can India replace a satellite in days? Vikram-1 opens a bigger space question
content: India’s space programme has traditionally been driven almost entirely by Isro. Private companies manufactured components, supplied technology and supported missions, but orbital launches remained the domain of the state. Vikram-1 changed that equation. For the first time, an Indian private company has demonstrated the ability to develop and operate an orbital launch vehicle.

title: Quote of the Day by Robert Frost: A reflection on mothers, love & life’s unexpected turns
content: Robert Frost remains a celebrated American poet known for his accessible yet profound verse. His poems often use rural imagery to explore deep human themes and choices. Frost's journey to success involved years of struggle before achieving recognition. He won four Pulitzer Prizes and recited at a presidential inauguration. His work continues to influence readers worldwide with its timeless insights.

title: Cricket club under fire after 'Clicky Ponting' finger-click cheating claim goes viral
content: An amateur cricket match has sparked controversy over alleged umpire deception. A fielder reportedly clicked his fingers to simulate an edge off the bat. This incident has led to a formal investigation by the league officials. Other similar allegations have also surfaced against the same club. The league is now examining the dismissals for deliberate deception.

title: Maharashtra CM directs withdrawal of FIRs against protesters involved in NEET stir
content: Maharashtra's Chief Minister has ordered the withdrawal of cases against protesting students.  These cases were registered during recent demonstrations supporting the Cockroach Janta Party.  Opposition parties urged the government to formally withdraw these pending legal actions.  Advocates warned that these cases could jeopardize students' futures and career prospects.  The Home Department will issue the necessary orders for case withdrawal soon.

title: 'Milestone' vs 'Pradhan saved Pradhan Mantri': Centre, oppn clash over anti-paper leak bill
content: The Lok Sabha is discussing a proposed amendment to the anti-paper leak law. This legislation aims to strengthen safeguards against examination fraud following the NEET exam leak. Union minister Jitendra Singh introduced the bill, reaffirming government commitment to student welfare. Congress criticized the government's response and the handling of student protests. The opposition also questioned the prioritization of social media over education reforms.

title: Roberto Mancini returns to rescue Italy after three straight FIFA World Cup misses
content: Roberto Mancini has been appointed Italy's new head coach, tasked with rebuilding the national team.  He previously led Italy to European Championship glory in 2021.  The team failed to qualify for the last three FIFA World Cups.  Claudio Ranieri joins as the federation's new technical director.  Mancini faces immediate challenges in the Nations League competition.

title: Ranbir Kapoor's 'Ramayana' trailer to release on July 30
content: The highly anticipated Ramayana: Part 1 trailer will premiere worldwide on July 30. This auspicious trailer launch is scheduled for Thursday at 4:15 AM IST. Fans expressed immense excitement across social media platforms following the official announcement. The film, directed by Nitesh Tiwari, features a star-studded ensemble cast. Ramayana: Part 1 is slated for a Diwali 2026 theatrical release.

title: Major changes in India support staff: Assistant coach quits; new fielding coach appointed
content: Ryan ten Doeschate has resigned as India's assistant coach after two years. Subhadeep Ghosh will now serve as the team's new fielding coach. Ten Doeschate cited personal reasons for stepping away from the demanding role. His final assignment was the recent white-ball tour of England. Ghosh's first international assignment will be the Sri Lanka Test series.

title: Gandhis vs Pralhad Joshi: 'Defender of rapists' charge meets 'authenticate it' challenge
content: Congress leaders Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and Rahul Gandhi criticised the Prime Minister's choice for education minister. They alleged the minister expressed happiness over the release of convicted rapists. This accusation stems from remarks made regarding the Bilkis Bano case convicts. The opposition leaders demanded substantiation of these serious allegations. The Union minister denied the claims and sought an apology from the Congress MP.

title: FIDE reveals host city for Gukesh vs Sindarov World Championship clash
content: Geneva, Switzerland, will host the 2026 FIDE World Championship Match.  Reigning champion Gukesh Dommaraju will defend his title against Javokhir Sindarov.  This historic contest will feature the youngest players ever to compete for the championship.  The match is scheduled to take place from November 25 to December 15.  FIDE selected Geneva as a neutral venue for this significant chess event.

title: Sana Saeed on battling bulimia for 6 years: 'I carried so much shame'
content: Actress Sana Saeed, best known for playing Shah Rukh Khan's daughter in 'Kuch Kuch Hota Hai', has opened up about her six-year battle with bulimia and the four years it took her to fully recover. In a new interview, the actress spoke about the shame she carried, the turning point in her healing, and the pressures around body image that shaped her struggle.

title: India’s 'looksmaxxing' economy: More science, more spending, fewer taboos
content: India's beauty market is rapidly expanding, driven by evolving consumer attitudes and increased awareness. Skincare routines now feature advanced ingredients, replacing older methods. Cosmetic procedures are becoming mainstream, with many seeking subtle enhancements. Digital platforms and influencers significantly shape purchasing decisions for beauty products. This shift reflects a move towards personalized wellness and a broader definition of beauty.

title: Govt must stop targeting, witch-hunting students: CJP warns of fresh peaceful protest
content: Abhijeet Dipke, CJP founder, has warned of a fresh nationwide protest. This action will occur if police harassment of students continues. Dipke stated the Cockroach Janta Party will respond with a massive peaceful protest. The government must stop targeting and witch-hunting students. This warning was issued via a post on X on Tuesday.

title: 'They still have plenty to offer': 'Asian Bradman' backs Virat, Rohit for 2027 World Cup
content: Zaheer Abbas, the former Pakistan captain, has thrown his weight behind Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma for the upcoming 2027 ODI World Cup. He emphasises that their vast experience and skills are crucial for India’s success. Abbas argues that fitness and scoring abilities should outweigh any concerns about age. Rohit’s recent impressive century against England has particularly strengthened his support for both senior players.

title: Ravi Mohan divorce case: Court rejects Rs 40 lakh alimony plea
content: The Chennai Family Welfare Court rejected a Rs 40 lakh monthly alimony plea.  Ravi Mohan must now pay Rs 3 lakh monthly until divorce proceedings conclude.  The court also allowed the actor unrestricted meetings with his two sons.  This order addresses financial and visitation disputes in the ongoing divorce case.  The long-running legal battle between Ravi Mohan and Aarti continues.

title: Ex-India U-19 WC hero stays behind bars after bail denied in match-fixing case
content: Manjot Kalra remains in Sri Lankan custody after a court rejected his bail plea. Investigators are pursuing a high-profile corruption probe linked to the Lanka Premier League. Several Sri Lankan cricketers have lodged complaints regarding alleged match-fixing approaches. Authorities possess recorded evidence connecting to the alleged approaches made to players. The controversy has also led to the termination of the Jaffna Kings franchise ownership.

title: 'Must Be Fair': High Court Refuses To Remove Cop Who Slapped Woman Protester
content: Justice Girish Kathpalia orally remarked that while any wrongdoing by the officer would have to be dealt with in accordance with the law, it would be inappropriate for the court to assume guilt before a fair trial.

title: Parliament Monsoon Session 2026 Live Updates: Paper Leaks Reflect Structural Flaws, Says Shashi Tharoor In Lok Sabha
content: Parliament Monsoon Session 2026 Live Updates: The Centre on Monday introduced the Bill in the Lok Sabha to amend the anti-paper leaks law, with provisions for stricter punishment of up to 10 years in jail and Rs 50 lakh fine

title: 'Delulu', 'Clock It': Gen Z Lingo Reaches Lok Sabha During Paper Leak Debate
content: As MPs discussed a Bill meant to stop examination paper leaks, they reached for Gen Z's vocabulary, probably to sound a little more in step with the young people whose protests had put the Bill on the table in the first place.

title: Dozens Feared Trapped As Mall Collapses After Strong Japan Earthquake
content: The strongest impact was felt in the Kumamoto region on Kyushu island, where the 7.1-magnitude earthquake struck, according to the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA).

title: The 1972 Treaty That Defines How India, Pak Talk To Each Other
content: The Shimla Agreement committed both countries to resolving their disputes, including Kashmir, through direct negotiation.

title: Assam Floods: Why Extreme Rainfall Turns Into A Recurring Disaster
content: 37,139.52 hectares of area under crop coverage are still submerged, while 26,679 animals have been washed away.

title: Priyanka Gandhi vs Anurag Thakur Over "Cow Urine Expert" Jab At IIT Professor
content: Addressing the Monsoon Session in the Lok Sabha, Priyanka Gandhi questioned the government's reliance on yet another committee to reform India's examination system.

title: In Poll Postmortem, CPM's Biggest Admission Is About Hindutva
content: In a statement that smacked of defeat, the document read, "The party is not sufficiently equipped to counter the RSS-BJP Hindutva-communal-corporate propaganda".

title: 2 Days, 2 Warnings: CJP Threatens To Restart Protest If Agitators Face Action
content: The CJP's Saurav Das said the Supreme Court had allowed the police to proceed with existing FIRs and expressed apprehension that the government would "weaponise" this against protesters.

title: 'Where To Kill Melania Trump': Video Threat From Iran, Warning For Son Barron
content: Titled "Where to Kill Melania", the video shows images of the first lady travelling in her motorcade and visiting locations across New York City. It even identifies luxury designer stores where she is known to shop.

title: "Strange Reaction": Rahul Gandhi On Pralhad Joshi As Education Minister Pick
content: Joshi had defended the early release of 11 men serving life terms for raping Bilkis Bano and killing her family during the 2002 Gujarat riots.

title: "Ear Was Almost Severed": Woman Recounts Police Crackdown During CJP Protest
content: Nutan Toppo, a resident of Jharkhand's Gumla district, said she had travelled to Delhi on July 20 to participate in the student demonstration.

title: Surat Locker Operator Steals Customers' Jewellery Worth Rs 2.67 Crore
content: The accused obtained duplicate keys and used them to open at least six lockers. All four accused have been arrested.

title: CPI(M) Alleges Delhi Police Tried To Arrest Student Leader At Party Office
content: CPI(M) General Secretary M A Baby termed the incident an "illegal attempt" by Delhi Police to enter the party headquarters to arrest Ghosh and described it as "a dangerous assault on democratic norms".

title: Tejasvi Surya's "Delulu" Jibe At Congress Over Paper Leak Bill
content: Tejasvi Surya said the student who is preparing for the next examination, "is more concerned about who is going to fix the system for the future".

title: Assam MLAs To Donate One Month's Salary For Flood Aid
content: Congress MLA from Srijangram, Nurul Islam, welcomed the decision and said it should have been taken earlier.

title: China Explores New Airport Project After Mongla Port Expansion In Bangladesh
content: Bangladesh's State Minister for Forests, Environment and Climate Change Dr Shaikh Faridul Islam said that the construction of Khan Jahan Ali Airport is crucial for easing communication in the southwest region and for expanding trade, commerce, and tourism.

title: Japan earthquake triggers blast in mall, several feared dead, trapped
content: a powerful 7.1-magnitude earthquake struck Japan's Kumamoto Prefecture . multiple people were trapped inside an Aeon shopping mall after the reported explosion . police feared "quite a few" people may have died, officials say .

title: 'Modiji clocked it': BJP MP's Gen Z-style praise for PM during anti-paper leak Bill debate
content: Aastha Jha is a writer at The Times of India, covering politics. title: 'Even her own party doesn't take her seriously, why should we?' CJP hits back at Kangana
content: the Cockroach Janta Party has dismissed BJP MP Kangana Ranaut's attack on young protesters . she said even her own party colleagues don't take her seriously . the BJP leader had launched a scathing attack on the young demonstrators who protested against the paper leak .

title: 'Garlanded as if he won a war': Oppn attacks BJP over Pradhan's felicitation

title: Remains of five infants found in French couple's home; partner made discovery
content: skeletal remains of four infants and decomposed body of a newborn were discovered at a couple's apartment in orange, southeastern France . the grisly discovery was made by the woman's partner, who alerted the prosecutor's office . prosecutors described it as a "third denial of pregnancy"

title: Trump’s 2-front challenge: Shades of 1914 as Zelenskyy, Netanyahu converge on Washington
content: the war in Ukraine and the conflict between Israel and Iran have unfolded as separate geopolitical dramas . the two appear closer than ever to becoming chapters of the same story . historians and diplomats have begun invoking the pre-1914 period of World War I as an analogy .

title: Demand for MSP, reforms: Protesting farmers breach police barricades enroute to Bhopal
content: farmers marching from Narmadapuram to Bhopal breached police barricades . demonstration began on Monday with a sit-in at sethanighat, a protest . farmers recited the Hanuman Chalisa before starting their march towards the city . police had attempted to stop the march by erecting bars at the district .

title: 'Corruption on Earth': Iran indicts Trump over Khamenei killing, faces death penalty
content: indictments have been completed in 140 cases linked to the war, including 74 involving the US government and Trump . charges against Trump include “corruption on earth”, murder, destruction, intentional assault and terrorist acts . the move marks one of Tehran’s stronger legal responses yet to the killing of Khamenei .

title: 'Unacceptable': CJP claims SC order contradicts govt assurance; warns of protest

title: CBI files chargesheet against 13 accused in NEET-UG paper leak case; hearing tomorrow
content: chargesheet filed by the economic offences Wing of the CBI will be placed before the special fast-track court constituted to hear paper leak cases on Wednesday . the case has been registered under Sections 315(5), 318(4), 61(2), 238 and 303(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023 .
